title: Jesus withdraws to Ephraim
description: Because the chief priests and the Pharisees plan to arrest him, Jesus no longer walks openly among the Jews but withdraws with his disciples to a town called Ephraim near the wilderness. As Passover approaches, people go up to Jerusalem to cleanse themselves and look for Jesus in the temple, asking if he will come to the feast [ref:Joh 11:54-57|John 11:54-57].
